name: 911 PO PDF Extractor
description: Extract PO packet data from PDFs to Excel with validation reports - prompts for folder when run
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: Have the folder of PO packet PDFs ready - you pick it when the app runs (it changes every batch, so it isn't a saved setting).
Make sure the PDFs are fully synced in OneDrive (not cloud-only placeholders) so they can be read.
how_it_works: Pick the folder of PO PDFs.
The app reads each PO packet, pulls the PO data into a structured table, and checks the values as it goes.
output: An Excel workbook of the extracted PO data, plus a validation report flagging anything that didn't read cleanly.

fields.label: Sentry Drone mode
fields.description: Pick the file or folder through the targeting-drone kill-cam - crosshair cursor, lock-on, and a railgun strike on the target. Off = a normal Explorer dialog. Buy the Sentry Drone at Woogy's Emporium; set every app at once from My Stuff.
